notes.title: Patch Notes – Version 30
notes.notes:
Fixed a critical memory leak that could cause performance degradation over time.

    Optimized resource usage to reduce overall CPU consumption, especially during long play sessions.

    Improved the movement system for better responsiveness and smoother control.

    Enhanced character dialogue system, including text rendering and animation during conversations.

    Corrected several typos and inconsistencies in in-game text and dialogue.

notes.title: Minor Patch: Bug Fixes & Performance
notes.notes: Fixed minor bugs and improved FPS and V-Sync performance.

notes.title: Goblins bugfix
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug where the goblins' hitboxes were not being detected in certain situations, along with other minor bugs.

Improved support for 21:9 aspect ratio.

Enhanced the sound effects for Alaric when killing enemies.

Added gamepad vibration feedback when hitting enemies.

Doubled the goblins' resistance.
